newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 11 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 11 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said on Wednesday that it qualified for bond insurance the following 11 municipal bond issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Pleasanton USD, Calif., $8.685 million and $7.315 million of GO bonds.
--Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority $200 million of general transportation bonds.
--Albuquerque, N.M., $46.715 million of water and sewer bonds.
--Dona Ana Br Comm, N.M., $3 million GOs.
--Newburgh City SD, N.Y., $3 million of GO school bonds.
--William Floyd UFSD, N.Y., $12.9 million of school district bonds.
--Commonwealth Tran BD, Va., $33 million transportation revs. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
